correctness.rationale: For D=bidirected K_{3,3} (18 arcs, six vertices), multipaths are exactly arc sets with indegree/outdegree <=1 and no directed cycles, including nine forbidden two-cycles. Independently enumerated all 2^18-1 masks: 714 nonempty faces, f=(18,108,264,252,72). Reconstructed the specified coordinate matching with 341 legal pairs, entire 2376-incidence oriented Hasse digraph acyclic, critical cells one 0-cell, 19 dimension-3 and 12 dimension-4. Independent exact signed integral gradient-path recursion yields the zero 19x12 degree-four Morse boundary; original result/verifier prove the same. Hurewicz pi_3(wedge^19 S^3)=Z^19 shows every 4-cell attachment null, giving wedge^19 S^3 vee wedge^12 S^4. Mod-2 ranks alone would not prove this integral homotopy.
